# Ali Sadikin Ma — AI Generalist

> Ali Sadikin Ma is an AI Generalist who turns frontier AI models into shipped products — not slide decks. 17 years building across 16 countries; ranked #1 at the Global AI Demo Day 2026. Now teaching what he builds.

## Who is Ali Sadikin Ma
Ali Sadikin Ma is an AI Generalist based in Batam, Indonesia. He builds and ships AI products end to end — and now teaches the same skills. In January 2026 he was ranked #1 at the Global AI Demo Day (Bengaluru, India), beating 26 startups across 16 countries. He runs INDUSIA.ai.

## What he builds — and teaches (course topics)
- Vibe Coding — production software at AI speed: prompts to deployed apps.
- AI Agent OS (MANDOR AI) — the operating system for your AI workforce; assign tasks to coding agents like teammates.
- Generative AI Video — cinematic, broadcast-ready video without a camera or crew.

## International recognition
- #1 Champion — Global AI Demo Day 2026 (Outskill AI Generalist Fellowship, Bengaluru)
- UN-UNCTAD × Alibaba eFounders Fellowship 2019 (1 of 48 in Asia, Hangzhou)
- Google Startup Grind — Silicon Valley 2018
- 1st Place — Telkomsel NextDev
- Wild Card Winner — Fenox Startup World Cup
- Top 8 Finalist — IDBYTE

## Can I learn AI from Ali?
Yes — Ali teaches AI Agents, Vibe Coding, and AI Video Generation through hands-on courses and a public build log at https://alisadikinma.com.
